name: devops
description: Devops arm (live capture of pipeline f8f8ba3e; runs the devops agent via blacksmith/agent, so the host blacksmith service must be up). Clones a repo, has the devops agent write a real source-grounded Dockerfile, TESTS it with a kaniko --no-push build (validates it builds; nothing is pushed), then publishes: if `ref` is set it pushes HEAD straight to that branch (e.g. dev); if `ref` is blank it seeds the repo and opens a bot-authored PR to dev. The image is built and pushed by the build-dev pipeline (on PR merge to dev, or triggered directly). Inputs {task, project, namespace, repo, ref}.

inputs.name: task
inputs.default: Write a Dockerfile for this service.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: existing branch to push to (blank = open a PR to dev)

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; __i=0; while [ "$(timeout 12 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$GF/healthz" 2>/dev/null)" = "000" ]; do __i=$((__i+1)); [ "$__i" -ge 10 ] && { echo 'git-factory unreachable after retries'; exit 1; }; echo "waiting for git-factory ($__i)"; sleep 5; done; git config --global http.lowSpeedLimit 1000; git config --global http.lowSpeedTime 30; REF='${inputs.ref}'; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; if [ -n "$REF" ]; then git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q "$REF"; echo "working on existing branch $REF:"; git log --oneline -1; else CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/r -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"name\":\"$REPO\",\"visibility\":\"private\",\"project\":\"${inputs.project}\"}"); case "$CODE" in 201|409) ;; *) echo "repo create failed $CODE"; cat /tmp/r; exit 1;; esac; if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads "$GIT_URL" main >/dev/null 2>&1; then D=$(mktemp -d); git -C "$D" init -q; git -C "$D" -c user.email=blacksmith@codearmory -c user.name=blacksmith commit -q --allow-empty -m 'chore: init main'; git -C "$D" push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/main; fi; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q main; echo 'cloned:'; git log --oneline -1; fi
/kaniko/executor --context dir:///workspace --dockerfile Dockerfile --no-push && echo DOCKERFILE_OK || { echo DOCKERFILE_BUILD_FAILED; exit 1; }

set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; __i=0; while [ "$(timeout 12 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$GF/healthz" 2>/dev/null)" = "000" ]; do __i=$((__i+1)); [ "$__i" -ge 10 ] && { echo 'git-factory unreachable after retries'; exit 1; }; echo "waiting for git-factory ($__i)"; sleep 5; done; git config --global http.lowSpeedLimit 1000; git config --global http.lowSpeedTime 30; cd /workspace; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; REF='${inputs.ref}'; if [ -n "$REF" ]; then BASE=$(git rev-parse "origin/$REF"); if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE" ]; then echo 'no new commits -- nothing to push'; exit 0; fi; git push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/$REF; echo "pushed the change to $REF"; exit 0; fi; BASE=$(git rev-parse origin/main); if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE" ]; then echo 'no commits from the stages -- nothing to publish'; exit 0; fi; TYPES=$(git log "$BASE"..HEAD --format=%s | sed -E 's/^([a-z]+)(\(.*\))?!?:.*/\1/' | sort -u); TYPE=chore; for t in feat fix perf refactor docs test build ci chore style revert; do if printf '%s\n' "$TYPES" | grep -qx "$t"; then TYPE=$t; break; fi; done; S=$(git log "$BASE"..HEAD --format=%s); if printf '%s' "$S" | grep -qE '^[a-z]+(\(.+\))?!:|BREAKING CHANGE'; then VS='v1.0'; else VS='v0.1'; fi; SLUG=$(printf '%s' "${inputs.task}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr -cs 'a-z0-9' '-' | sed -E 's/^-+//; s/-+$//' | cut -c1-40 | sed -E 's/-+$//'); [ -z "$SLUG" ] && SLUG=change; BR=$TYPE/${SLUG}; if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads "$GIT_URL" dev >/dev/null 2>&1; then git push "$GIT_URL" "$BASE":refs/heads/dev; fi; git push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/$BR; RID=$(curl -s "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | sed -E 's/.*\"id\":\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/' | head -1); PR=$(curl -s -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"title\":\"$VS $TYPE: ${inputs.task}\",\"source_ref\":\"$BR\",\"target_ref\":\"dev\",\"author\":\"f8406f21-36b7-4398-b898-a76b36899ac0\"}"); echo "$PR"; echo PR_OPENED
